anomalies.observed: C5 (100n) and C6 (100n) are connected between the switch node net REG_SW and GND.
anomalies.expected: Switch node should only connect to the inductor L1 and bootstrap capacitor C4; capacitors to GND belong on the input (PVIN/VCC) or output (+5V) rails.

evidence.quote: Main buck regulator (5 V rail) ... MIC26903YJL-TR ... L = 15uH for 5% ripple current

anomalies.impact: Creates a high-frequency short on the switch node, causing excessive power loss, potential regulator failure, and EMI.

anomalies.observed: PS pin (pin 7) of BMI088 is tied to +3.3V.
anomalies.expected: For I2C operation as specified, PS must be tied to GND (0 = I2C).

evidence.quote: IMU (accel + gyro) | NAVCPeripherals | Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: IMU will be configured for SPI mode and will not respond to I2C commands, disabling the IMU.

anomalies.observed: STM32F405RGTx symbol has VREF+ on pin 20 and VREF- on pin 21.
anomalies.expected: On STM32F405RGTx LQFP-64, pin 20 is PA4 and pin 21 is PA5; VREF+ is not available and is internally connected to VDDA.

evidence.quote: NAVC1 STM32F405RGTx (Cortex-M4, 168 MHz, 1 MB flash, LQFP-64)

anomalies.impact: VREF+ net is incorrectly connected to GPIO PA4, and VREF- to PA5, likely causing analog reference failure and MCU malfunction.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains three significant anomalies: extra capacitors on the buck switch node (C5, C6), the BMI088 IMU PS pin tied high instead of ground for I2C, and an incorrect VREF+ pin assignment on the STM32F405RGTx NAVC.
